dashboard_insights.message: Over the period the account spent A$4,648 of the A$25,575 monthly budget, about 18%. Spend is overspend risk.
The account generated 407 leads at A$11.42 cost per lead, below the A$16.42 target.
NSW Campaigns is the single largest spend at A$1,001 (22% of spend) at A$22.76 per lead. New South Wales is the largest state at A$1,001.
NSW | Leads | Testing Creatives | MOF delivered the most leads (66) at A$9.75. Lowest cost per lead at scale: Spike | NSW | Leads | Cranes and Tray Trucks | MOF at A$5.49.
Least efficient campaigns: NSW Campaigns (A$22.76), all above the A$16.42 target.
Hard waste is minimal: A$69.75 produced zero leads. About A$419 (9.0% of spend) sits above the target benchmark on high cost-per-lead assets.

Only 3 of 10 delivering campaigns use the EMPLOYMENT special ad category. Driver-recruitment ads are employment ads under Meta policy, so the rest should also be set to EMPLOYMENT to stay compliant and avoid delivery or targeting restrictions.
The account still optimises against form-fill rather than hire; confirm pixel/CAPI events and progress SubHub integration so optimisation can move from cost per form to cost per hire.
Campaign naming maps cleanly overall. Test campaigns use state prefixes so they classify as Test, not their state: VIC JCF | TOF | Experimental Campaign, NSW | Leads | Testing Creatives | MOF.
By state: QLD A$10.18, WA A$10.64, VIC A$10.65, SA A$15.02, NSW A$22.76.
Creative-test campaigns produced leads at about A$9.35, well below target. Scale the winning angles into the state campaigns.

Recommended next steps: set EMPLOYMENT special ad category on all driver campaigns; review the high cost-per-lead state campaigns; scale winning test angles; progress SubHub and CAPI to optimise on hires.

data_quality_notes: All figures pulled live from Meta Ads Manager via Pipeboard MCP using 7d_click_1d_view attribution, timezone Australia/Sydney.
Budget pacing benchmarks period spend against the monthly budget.
Headline totals use the account-level pull; campaign breakdowns sum to A$4,650.94 and reconcile to the account total within Meta per-level rounding.
Deduplicated account reach and frequency come from the non-segmented account pull, not summed campaign reach.
Leads use the Meta 'lead' action, matching the Ads Manager Leads column.
Landing page views are low relative to leads because the account uses Meta instant forms.
Qualified-lead and hire stages are null pending SubHub and CAPI.
